Nora: RCA is published for the spike+fallback cascade: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2177770000-spike-fallback-cascade
Nora: Quick summary: simultaneous region failover + policy fallback caused a surge of retried requests and temporary SLO violations for ~15m. Root cause: fallback routing didn't respect in-flight capacity signals.
Nora: Full timeline, diffs, and anonymized request samples are in the doc. Please review owners and targets.
Nora: Action items (owners + due dates):
- Ilya - enforce in-flight capacity check in fallback router + unit tests - target 2026-04-04
- Bea - add canary gating for cross-region failovers and a 10-min cooldown - target 2026-03-31
- Ken - telemetry: add "fallback_retry_ratio" metric and an alert at 0.5% sustained - target 2026-03-29
Ilya: I'll open a patch today and include a deterministic test harness for concurrent failover paths. Tagging @eng-runtime for review.
Bea: I'll prototype the gating logic and propose a rollback threshold. Will attach the proto in the doc.
Ken: I'll add the metric and a dashboard mock; will link screenshots to the RCA doc.
